node.statement: Apply lem-stage1-polar-retraction with its fixed constants (C_*, kappa_*) to the arbitrary algebra and delta, using the guard from the preceding step. With S_delta taken to be the image Pi_delta(calU x B^{calH}_delta(J)), it gives that S_delta is open, Pi_delta is a C^1 diffeomorphism onto S_delta, the inverse (u_delta,h_delta) has X = u_delta(X) bold-dot h_delta(X), u_delta(U) = U, and h_delta(U) = J, and it gives the base sandwich calU_{delta - C_*A} subseteq S_delta subseteq calU_{delta + C_*A}.
